segments.label: Historical heading
segments.original:
CAP. XLVIII.
BANDO
SOPRA LA SANITA’.

segments.label: Precautionary suspension of Civitavecchia
segments.original: Sentendosi, che nello Spedale di Ciuità Vecchia siano seguiti due casi ne’ Seruenti di esso, con qualche sospetto di Contagio; per preuenire ogni sinistro, con la prouidenza, & applicatione consueta della Santità di Nostro Signore si sospende di suo espresso ordine la Terra di Ciuità Vecchia, con impositione delle solite pene à chiunque contrauenisse, &c.
segments.english: It being reported that two cases have occurred among the attendants of the hospital at Civitavecchia, with some suspicion of contagion, to prevent every misfortune, with the customary providence and attention of His Holiness Our Lord, the town of Civitavecchia is suspended by his express command, with the customary penalties imposed on anyone who contravenes, etc.

notes.text: The date reads 29 May in the image; the PDF OCR misreads it. Chapter 49 also expressly recalls the proclamation of the twenty-ninth.
The document reports two cases among hospital attendants and some suspicion of contagion. It does not give diagnoses or enumerate the “customary” penalties anew.
